trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, and progress you made during the story already counts. It is far more forgiving than it sounds, closer to 60% true completion: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts. Nothing on the list is missable, and it is all still doable in free-roam after the story. Required in full: all robberies (8 bank vaults and 39 gang operations), underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold medal, all drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks. (GTABase)

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on notifications under Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile, and a demon face shows whenever an action counts. agreements: All ten sources list the same 55 trophies — 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden, 0 online.
Time to platinum: PowerPyx, GTABase and GTADb say around 200 hours; Push Square says 250+ hours (up to 300). The guide uses ~200 hours, the majority figure.

Missable: PowerPyx, GTABase and GTADb all flag Positive Mental Attitude as possibly missable (the Chapter 1 meditation with Lucia); Push Square lists “None known yet”. The guide flags it and tells you to do the meditation while you can.

Unconfirmed triggers: GTABase (18 Nov) lists the exact steps as unconfirmed for Bad Luck, I Guess; Ten Pin; In The Beginning…; Capital Offense; and The Truth Is Out There. PowerPyx gives a route for four of the five — In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, The Truth Is Out There and Ten Pin — and calls Bad Luck, I Guess currently unknown. The guide shows the routes and marks all five unconfirmed. Which animal triggers Fair Game is also not yet confirmed (GTABase).
Shooting ranges: Push Square lists two locations; GTABase counts 42 gold medals across 12 ranges. Both agree on 42 gold medals.
100% completion does not need everything: GTABase and Push Square agree on 15 of 18 card sets, 70 of 80 challenges and 300 stunts.
Missable, checked again: PSNProfiles’ list carries no missable flags at all (it is a trophy list, not a guide), so it neither confirms nor contradicts the one possibly-missable trophy.
